symptom: Synthetic re-digested shadow evidence could claim PASS with zero unresolved/rejected rows while retaining positive reason counts in the corresponding category. The validator enforced only a lower bound on reason coverage, so a zero-row category could contain contradictory reason evidence. No actual SQLite, K-source or production data was involved.
lesson: Reason coverage lower bounds preserve legitimate multi-reason rows but do not enforce the zero-row boundary. When a category contains no rows, its own reason-count total must be exactly zero even if a recomputed digest and taxonomy are internally consistent.
guardrail: Validate unresolved and rejected reason totals as exactly zero when their corresponding row counts are zero; preserve lower-bound coverage for nonzero counts and multi-reason rows. Regress re-digested positive reason maps against zero-row PASS evidence without using private or production inputs.
